description: This file defines the class HolidaySearchFilterParams which extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams and is part of the OrangeHRM leave plugin. It encapsulates search filter parameters specifically for holiday searches, including a boolean to exclude recurring holidays and a predefined sort field.

classes.name: HolidaySearchFilterParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class for specifying search filters related to holiday queries within the HRM system. It includes mechanisms to set sorting and options to exclude recurring holidays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters and sets the default sort field to 'holiday.date'.

methods.name: isExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Returns whether recurring holidays are excluded from the search.

methods.name: setExcludeRecurring
methods.description: Sets whether to exclude recurring holidays from the search results.
